held_out_result.fresh_process_verification: clean on base AND evaluated mesh: 0 non-manifold edges, 0 ngons, 0 loose geometry, 0 degenerate faces, positive signed volume
held_out_result.construction: single continuous elliptical loft, 78 stations, every station's X/Y half-extent and center offset read from measured front/side reference row widths -- not a body of revolution or armature skeleton; ring vertices placed at equal angular spacing for clean circumferential edge loops
held_out_result.hard_surface_shading_policy: corrected 2026-08-13 on direct user review -- the first version shipped with zero bevel weighting and blanket smooth shading, skipping this project's own established policy entirely. Fixed in place (same script, same file): weighted the two reference-confirmed collar/step seams (housing/shaft, shaft/handle), added a WEIGHT-limited Bevel modifier (0.012 width), applied Smooth by Angle. hard_surface_shading_audit now reports PASS. IoU improved slightly as a side effect, not the goal.
held_out_result.reverted_investigation: a second candidate split the loft into a separate Movable_Jaw part at rows confirmed two-lobe by direct pixel run-length analysis; measured front IoU regressed 0.916856 to 0.911423 and recall 0.982389 to 0.973345, so it was reverted rather than kept
